result.title: Which Geometry on Which Layer? Measured Sign-Spectral Assignment in Mixed-Optimizer Training
result.summary: Modern neural-network training uses mixed recipes, assigning AdamW-like or sign-based updates to embedding and output layers and spectral updates to hidden matrices. These assignments are usually fixed by layer type, without a clear criterion for selecting the appropriate geometry. We turn sign-versus-spectral assignment into a measurable, layerwise decision problem. For ideal memoryless steps, we derive a finite-batch ratio of conservative descent-lemma lower bounds for spectral and sign updates. Its closed form separates signal efficiency from a geometry-dependent global curvature factor. In the positive-signal regime, the same smoothness assumption gives two-sided bounds that determine which step has the larger conditional expected decrease when the ratio crosses explicit noise-dependent thresholds. We then derive a local directional quadratic score from gradient alignments and Hessian-vector products and use it in Generalized-Scion (G-Scion) to control layerwise routing. In a controlled input-rank experiment, including directional curvature matches the measured same-iterate ordering in all seven aggregate settings, whereas the curvature-free proxy selects the opposite geometry. On 31M GPT-2, the output score routes the output layer from spectral warmup to sign, and G-Scion improves validation loss over fixed Scion in memoryless and matched-momentum comparisons. ViT-B/16 results further show that a spectral edge assignment can outperform fixed Scion outside language modelling. These results suggest that optimizer geometry need not be hard-coded by layer type and are a first step toward understanding how it should be assigned.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把混合优化器中「sign 更新 vs spectral 更新」的按层分配转成可测量的逐层决策问题：为理想无记忆步推导两种保守下降界之比的闭式（区分信号效率与几何相关曲率因子），再由梯度对齐与 Hessian-向量乘积构造局部方向二次分数，用于 G-Scion 的逐层路由；受控输入秩实验中含曲率的方向分数与实测同迭代排序一致，31M GPT-2 与 ViT-B/16 上路由可改善或匹敌固定 Scion。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但「用梯度对齐与曲率构造逐层可测分数、据此切换更新几何」的诊断式路由与代价比较思路，可能可供核查 latent 推理模块中不同深度层、不同更新规则的选择与监督分配设计。
